notes: Units: every stack exists on storeys 2-26 (25 storeys); storey 1 is void deck. Block 433A stacks 405 and 407 are rental flats (not for sale, 50 units) and are excluded from stacks and units.

Facing: from board row5 arrows (colour-coded vector arrows, legend NW magenta, NE blue, SW red, SE purple); 35 arrows match the 35 sale stacks one to one and also agree with the front-semicircle direction in row3. A 36th stray blue NE arrow sits on the MSCP roof (no unit) and was ignored. North arrow on the site plan points straight up (north_bearing_deg 0).

gt30m: board row3 semicircles are drawn with a 15 m radius (labelled '15m', about 14 m by the scale bar), not 30 m; the user's red/green colour was taken as the decision. Each stack has one front (living-room side) semicircle; 26 stacks also have a second, sideways semicircle (added in a later drawing pass). Rule applied: the stack passes only if all of its own semicircles are green; evidence.front_only gives the result using only the front semicircle. Attribution is by semicircle centre (straight-edge midpoint) lying on the unit; all centres are within 5 pt (2.4 m) of the unit label except two extra red SE semicircles centred on the '8' future-amenities markers on the east parts of 465 and 461 (attributed to those units).

gt30m pass 1 = colours read from the board's vector shapes; pass 2 = pixel samples on a fresh 3000 dpi render inside each own semicircle. Heavy overlap makes pass 2 unreliable; disagreements are listed below and were resolved by attribution (a neighbour's red drawn over your own green does not fail you; your own red counts even if a neighbour's green covers it). Annotated check images: opp/annot2_433A.png, annot2_433B.png, annot2_434A.png.

Facilities: board row2 has 13 circles of 29.6 m radius around site-plan legend markers 1 Children's playground (x2), 2 Adult fitness station (x2, one on the MSCP roof garden), 3 Elderly fitness station, 4 Precinct pavilion (x2), 5 Drop-off porch (x2), 6 'Space reserved for future community use' (mapped to Community space, on the MSCP roof), 7 Preschool at 1st storey (in MSCP Block 433), 8 Future amenities/facilities at 1st storey (x2, under 434A). facilities_near = circle overlaps the unit footprint (segmented from the site-plan colours). facilities_has: only 434A has an in-block facility (Future amenities/facilities, 1st storey, facilities_1st_storey.json); Preschool and Community space are in the MSCP, not a residential block.

chute_m: distance from main door to the centralised refuse chute (one per block, next to the lift lobby wash area) on the 2nd-26th storey plan, measured by eye at 300-400 dpi; door positions are good to about 1 m.

position: Corner = last unit door along its corridor branch from the lift lobby. 401/403 and 451/453 each have their own short stub off the lobby (each one is Corner). 471/473 share a dead-end stub and both are marked Corner. 425/427 and 449/447 open off the lobby edge; 425 and 449 were judged the farther doors (medium confidence).

roof_floors is [] for all stacks: no unit opens directly onto an accessible roof garden (the MSCP roof garden is a separate building). roof_note_2nd_storey is true where a 'ROOF AT 2ND STOREY ONLY' label points to a roof right next to the stack on the floor plan (433A: 401, 417, 419; 433B: 429, 431, 437, 449; 434A: 451, 453, 455, 457, 459, 469, 471, 473). Labels next to the lift lobby/wash area or the rental flats were not assigned to any sale stack.

wind_open: checks whether any other residential block's unit footprint lies within 30 m on a bearing of 90-135 deg, from anywhere on the unit's footprint (whole unit, not only the window). Only 433A #403 fails (433B #425 about 12 m away); the rental stack 405 would also fail.

mscp_m: shortest distance from the unit footprint to the MSCP (Block 433) building outline (the green roof-garden deck, without the brown linkway frame), rounded to 5 m. Per block, the values bracket mscp_distance.json (433A 25, 433B 35, 434A 25, measured from the block centre): the near stacks are 10-15 m and the far stacks up to 55 m.
mrt_m: null; there is no MRT station on the site plan.
Independent review 2026-10-13: units 875/875, facing/gt30m/wind 35/35 agree; facilities and car park now block-wide (user rule); 427 Corner; 449 chute 10.2 m.
